evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Story provides the creation capability for games, which is complemented by read, update, and delete stories elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators is a necessary step and is not missing any complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing items is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is supported by item creation and viewing stories.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list
evaluations.rationale: Provides creation capability for items to be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Edit is complemented by create (PP-006), read (PP-004), and delete (PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Delete is complemented by create (PP-006) and read (PP-004).

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and display are covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation, display, and acceptance are all present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Automatic filling is a complementary feature to estimate creation and acceptance.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Estimate entry is supported by creation and acceptance stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported by item management and estimate creation stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is a creation method, complemented by read, update, and delete elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Another creation method for items, with complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing (read) is complemented by create (PP-001), update (PP-021, PP-023), and delete (PP-020).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing is complemented by creation (PP-001, PP-012) and export (PP-018, PP-019).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export is a complementary feature to viewing and creating transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export is a complementary feature to viewing and creating transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete is complemented by create (PP-001), read (PP-016), and update (PP-023).

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is complemented by read (PP-022), update (PP-023), and delete (PP-024).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login (read) is complemented by account creation (PP-021), update (PP-023), and delete (PP-024).

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Update is complemented by create (PP-021), read (PP-022), and delete (PP-024).

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Delete is complemented by create (PP-021), read (PP-022), and update (PP-023).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a feature that does not require complementary CRUD operations.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a complementary feature to account management.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with different sequences
evaluations.rationale: Selecting estimation sequence is a configuration feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation is supported by game creation and estimator joining stories.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining is supported by invitation and game creation stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing is supported by item creation and management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and display are covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and display are covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and update are covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is supported by estimate creation and storage.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Estimate creation and display are covered by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer
evaluations.rationale: Timer is a standalone feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset is a complementary feature to timer start.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior rounds is supported by estimate and item creation and storage.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order
evaluations.rationale: Card order is a display feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate update is supported by estimate creation and display.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed
evaluations.rationale: Photo display is a standalone feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compliance is a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary is a standalone feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexes are a technical feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance is a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL structure is a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error pages are a non-functional requirement; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized storage is a data handling feature; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics display is a standalone feature; no missing complementary capability.
